title: DVR torsion calculation for one completed constant perfect value
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l a finite extension, A=O_E its actual valuation ring and pi its uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For schemes T and X and any map g:X -> T, put d=pbcPadicCoefficientDatum(l,E), B=pbcAdicCompletion(T,d) and B'=g^{-1}B [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let C be a perfect A-complex [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], let K=integralConstantDerived(T,d)(C) [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models], and fix q. Then g^*H^q(K) is isomorphic to F direct-sum N, where F has a sectionwise basis of one finite rank over B'. There is a nilpotent endomorphism f of N and an index n such that cokernel(f) is an epimorphic image of g^*Tor_1^{R_(n+1)}(H^q(K_(n+1)),R_n), restricted along g^{-1}(B -> R_n). Here R_n denotes the actual quotient coefficient sheaf at exponent n+1 and K_n the derived reduction. No noetherian condition on T or X, constructibility predicate, stratification, or local-model existence is assumed.

proof.text: Represent C by a bounded finite-projective complex over the valuation DVR. All terms are finite free. At the highest degree, Smith-normal-form bases diagonalize the differential image in the highest term. Lift the free image basis to split its preceding term into the image lifts and the differential kernel. The incoming differential lands in that kernel, so the diagonal two-term blocks split as complexes. Iterate downward. Absorb diagonal units into basis vectors; discard contractible unit blocks. The degree-q one-term blocks give A^r and positive-power cokernel blocks give the finite torsion module. Completed realization and inverse image give F and N. A uniformizer power bounded by the maximum block exponent kills N. Finite free realization gives a basis on every object, including the empty object.

Choose n at least the largest positive torsion exponent. For S=A/(pi^(n+2)) -> R=A/(pi^(n+1)), the periodic free resolution of R has differential pi^(n+1) in degree -1 to zero, pi in degree -2 to -1, and then alternates. Cancellation in the DVR proves its exactness. Tensoring with each degree-q cokernel block A/(pi^s), where s<=n+1, gives Tor_1=(A/(pi^s))/pi. The bounded-complex block decomposition makes those blocks direct summands in H^q of the reduction; other blocks can contribute and are projected away. Thus their Tor_1 sum surjects onto N/pi N. Exact constant sheafification and completed finite-complex realization compare the actual quotient reductions with this calculation. Bounded-above free resolutions compute derived scalar extension; exact inverse image and tensor comparison give the stated source after coefficient restriction. Multiplication by pi is the nilpotent f. For no torsion take N=0 and the epimorphism to zero; no nonempty-chart assumption is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem pbc_constant_perfect_dvr_torsion_calculation
    (T X : Scheme.{u}) (g : X ⟶ T)
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (C : completedConstantDerived
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))
    (hC : @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) C)
    (q : ℤ) :
    let d := pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E
    let B := pbcAdicCompletion T d
    let K := (integralConstantDerived T d).obj C
    let B' := (adicTowerInverseImage g).obj B
    let P := proEtaleRingModulePullback g B B' (Iso.refl _)
    let tor (n : ℕ) := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (-1)).obj
      ((pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n))).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            ((pbcCompletedReduction T d (n + 1)).obj K))))
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (F N : pbcModules X B'),
      (∀ U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ,
        Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin r) (B'.obj.obj U) (F.val.obj U))) ∧
      Nonempty (P.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K) ≅ F ⊞ N) ∧
      ∃ f : End N, IsNilpotent f ∧ ∃ n : ℕ,
        ∃ t : (pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
            (pbcAdicProjection T d n))).obj
          ((proEtaleRingModulePullback g ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n))
            ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n)))
            (Iso.refl _)).obj (tor n)) ⟶ cokernel f,
          Epi t
